entries.justification: The command is a compile-time constant ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel') with no caller-supplied content; the shell is involved only because execSync takes a string, and no argument material is interpolated. The repository's policy for anything argument-bearing is execFileSync with an array.
Same class as line 54: the execSync argument is a constant git command string spanning the following lines; no caller-supplied or derived content is interpolated into the shell string.

The specifier is a file URL the loader itself constructs from a corpus path that has passed the shared path-confinement primitive (the corpus file is confined to the corpus directory and verified on a descriptor before this import is reached); the dynamic form is how the variant module is loaded from the confined location. The confinement, not the import form, is the enforced boundary.
